description: The visual enables users to connect to the Power ON Visual Planner Service and write-back to various data sources from Power BI, including robust planning, data management and data collection features such as: Read/Write in Pivot Tables • Comments/Remarks/Annotations on any data point • Smart Formulas and Goal-Seek • Statistical, Operational, or Financial metrics in a Pivot Table experience • Actual, Forecast, and Planning data in the same matrix • Client-side calculations and layout • Immediate updates across related visuals and data points • Plan for Expense, Revenue, Sales, Supply, Demand, Inventory, HR, and more • Adjust numbers with a mouse or touch screen using Drag & Drop visual values • Change the data while maintaining Row-level security in Power BI • Full Audit Log capabilities • Edit detailed data in tables using rich controls • The visual requires a Power ON Visual Planner subscription • Learn more at: https://poweronbi.com/powerbi-visual-planning • Windows authentication support
